the push strategy changes quite a bit. You want to apply poison to everything you can while you gather up high density mob types. This will get your Poison DoT's going which require 10 seconds to reach max damage, so the sooner you get poison on everything the better. You'll want to gather as much as you can on top of Elite packs, drop Poison trap, Dash through enemies after they get pulled in by Kry rune, and Spin to win until everything dies. Every enemy that dies will increase damage stacks from Black Soulstone giving us a large amount of damage to help kill Elites faster. With the updated
node, its important to make sure you apply all 4 (Dash, Trap, Marksman, Cutthroat) damage types on everything for max damage.

its important to take damage at least once every 8 seconds. For clearing this isn't an issue but some boss fights can be difficult to keep the damage buff active. Don't try to dodge everything on Boss fights or Blood-Mad damage buff will fall off.
